decisive_spans.text: More than five schistocytes/HPF, presence of anisocytosis and some spherocytes

response.rationale: The presence of more than five schistocytes/HPF and anisocytosis and some spherocytes strongly supports Thrombotic Microangiopathy. While DIC is supported by thrombocytopenia and anemia, the specific blood smear findings are more indicative of TMA. Alcoholic Hemolytic Anemia is contradicted by the schistocytes.
